hypothesis: Retraining the frozen E005 recipe on the 62 reserved complementary-fold trajectories will beat complementary-fold persistence on Rel-L2, TKE, and MVPE, and will not collapse at Re 6300 by more than 1.5 Rel-L2 or 3.0 TKE versus that fold's persistence.
comparator: persistence on the frozen complementary fold, computed once in the same evaluation pass

data.normalization: train-only Gaussian statistics over the 62 reserved complementary-fold training files

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update; no validation-based early stopping

success_criteria.sps: reported but excluded from the robustness gate because uncertainty is unchanged

controls_held_equal_to_e005: per-window physical relative squared u/v loss
seed, shuffle order, batch size, and update count
optimizer, learning rate, scheduler, precision, and no gradient clipping
controls_changed_from_e005: training files are the 62 reserved complementary-fold trajectories
the single evaluation uses the unused 19-file complementary fold rather than E002
E002 validation trajectories are in the E010 training set and must not be treated as holdout evidence
promotion: evidence only; do not package or submit from E010
limitations: A pass supports the E005 recipe, not the E005/E008 checkpoint, because that checkpoint trained on these holdout files.
These complementary groups are unused-pool holdouts, not global dataset edges.
Default-interval SPS is not a promotion criterion.
Codabench scores are not used for parameter selection.
